title: Implement Build Dependency Topological Sorter with Cycle Path Detection
description: In the dependency resolution module (src/dep_resolver.py), implement the `DependencyResolver` class. Given a dependency graph mapping package names to lists of dependencies `{pkg: [dep1, dep2, ...]}`, implement `resolve_build_order(graph: Dict[str, List[str]]) -> List[str]`. All dependencies must precede the target package in the resulting list. When multiple valid topological orders are possible, break ties alphabetically to ensure deterministic order. If a circular dependency exists in the graph, raise `CircularDependencyError` and populate its `cycle_path: List[str]` attribute with the exact cycle nodes (e.g. `['A', 'B', 'C', 'A']`).
